description: This script encodes firmware files for MOXA IW devices by adding headers, computing CRCs, and encrypting the data. It processes a firmware binary, partitions it into predefined sections, adds headers, performs encryption, and writes the output.
external_files: None explicitly referenced, but the script reads from an input file and writes to an output file specified by command-line arguments.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Data class representing a firmware partition with a name and size.

methods.name: bytes xor(data: bytes)
methods.description: Performs a simple XOR encryption/decryption on the data using a cyclic passphrase.

methods.name: bytes add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
methods.description: Adds a firmware header with metadata and offsets to the data.

methods.name: bytes add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int)
methods.description: Adds a file header with filename and CRC to the data.

methods.name: int crc(data: bytes, init_val: int)
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum with an initial value, returning a masked checksum.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main execution function that processes the firmware file, partitions it, adds headers, encrypts, and writes output.

ctags.name: add_file_header
ctags.pattern: /^def add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int) -> bytes:$/

ctags.name: add_fw_header
ctags.pattern: /^def add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int,$/
ctags.signature: (data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
